parameters.formDescription: Upload a CSV exported from Evaluation Log. Include stable Test_ID, a new Run_ID for new posts, brief, approved source text, and Context_Status READY. Human reviews are preserved for unchanged posts only.

parameters.content:
## Human-led publication evaluation
Fill the approved context, independently critique and label exact outputs, then calibrate the judge. Jev returns one PASS/FAIL choice. The separate LLM critique is an independent opinion, never Jev reasoning.

Attach Header Auth (Authorization: Bearer <OpenRouter API key>) to each HTTP node. No credentials are shipped. Use a new Run_ID for new posts; keep the same Test_ID and brief. Generation is one pass so baseline and revisions remain inspectable. ERROR, SKIPPED, AMBIGUOUS and NEEDS_CONTEXT are execution states, never quality labels.

Download the CSV from Download Results CSV. Match its 35 columns to Evaluation Log. See docs/walkthrough.md for the complete current demo.
